1.desc1: Countless structures were destroyed in a disaster. Amid the ruins, salvageable resources lie buried beneath the debris. Clear away the clutter to uncover them.
1.desc2:
1. This event features 2 stages. Each run must start from stage 1.
2. Tap cards to place them into the card slots below. Match 3 identical cards in the slots to clear them.
3. You can get one card reward upon clearing cards.
4. You may use 3 items: Remove, Recall, Refresh.
Remove: Move the first 3 cards in the slots to the removal area (max 4 stacks).
Recall: Return the last placed card to its original position.
Refresh: Reshuffle the card positions in the elimination area.
5. If the card slots are full, you fail the stage.
6. Clear all cards to beat the stage.
